title: Left Main Wing
label: SOURCED
summary: Clipped-diamond / trapezoidal left main wing with 42° leading-edge sweep, forward-swept trailing edge, and integral fuel volume.
role: Generates primary lift for high-altitude supercruise and high-G agility while aligning planform edges for stealth.
materials: Titanium spars and root fittings with composite intermediate spars and monolithic carbon-composite skins.

modelingNotes.proportionReference: USAF wingspan (13.56 m), wing area (78.04 m²), 42° LE sweep
